body.name: Balanced exhaustive allocation subdomain
body.construction:
On the balanced exhaustive subdomain \(K\mid N\), put \(n=N/K\) and define
\[
\mathcal Z_{N,K}=\left\{z\in\mathcal A^N:
\sum_{i=1}^N\mathbf 1(z_i=a)=n\ \text{for every }a\in\mathcal A
\right\}.
\]
This is the subdomain used by \(\mathfrak P^{\mathrm{bal}}_{N,K}\) and \(\mathfrak K^{\mathrm{bal}}_{N,K}\); it is not the general sample-and-assign space \(\mathcal Z^{\circ}_{N,\mathbf n}\).
